_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: SBM MobiKwik First Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: Cashback card: cashback is credited to the MobiKwik Wallet in rupees and "can be encashed or transferred to the bank account" (rewards T&C).

eligibility_engine.notes: FD-backed secured card: the credit limit is 90% of the fixed deposit (KFS). The minimum deposit is not stated in the SBM documents read.

action.reason: Dating and escort services and gambling earn no cashback (rewards T&C excluded-MCC table).
Government services and tax payments earn no cashback (rewards T&C).
"Funding transaction" (MCC 5406 in the cashback list) earns no cashback.
"Funding transaction" (MCC 6540 in the shared excluded table, section 4) earns no cashback.
Financial institutions (merchandise and services) earn no cashback.
Real estate agents and rentals earn no cashback.
Transactions converted to EMI earn no cashback, even if the EMI is later foreclosed or cancelled (rewards T&C).

conditions.platform: any UPI app other than MobiKwik

action.reason: UPI transactions with the card registered on any app other than MobiKwik (Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe and others) earn nothing (rewards T&C: "NIL").
1% cashback on UPI transactions made through the MobiKwik app with the card, minimum transaction value ₹2,000 (rewards T&C, programme effective 1 Feb 2026).
1% cashback on online e-commerce and offline POS merchants, no minimum transaction value; rounded to the nearest rupee per transaction (rewards T&C, effective 1 Feb 2026).

components: 5% of the outstanding amount or ₹100, whichever is greater (POS/ECOM)
plus overdue minimum payments, any amount over the credit limit and EMI instalments due

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Membership and annual maintenance fees are nil (KFS; MITC Table 01). Physical card fee ₹200; card cancellation within six months of activation ₹200 (KFS; MITC Table 06).

direct_options.channel: MobiKwik Wallet: cashback credited within 7 working days of statement generation, can be encashed or transferred to the bank account

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: SBM MobiKwik First Credit Card KFS (SBM file dated 12 Oct 2026): fees, interest, late fee, forex, cash limit

SBM MobiKwik First Card Rewards Program T&C: cashback programme effective 1 Feb 2026 (PDF created 10 Feb 2026, SBM file dated 12 May 2026); also keeps the superseded SuperCash programme valid till 31 Jan 2026

SBM Secured Credit Card MITC and Cardholder Member Agreement, 52 pages (SBM file dated 29 Oct 2026): Tables 01-11 give fees, interest, late fee, forex, surcharge, rent and education fees, cash limits and minimum due for every variant
SBM secured credit card page (read 7 Nov 2026): lists the card with its KFS, MITC and reward links; card image https://www.sbm.bank.in/images/cards/mobikwik-card.webp shows the network

open_questions: Network: no SBM document names it. RuPay is read from the card image on the SBM page (the RuPay logo is on the MobiKwik First card); the rewards T&C also treats the card as UPI-linked, which fits a RuPay credit card.
No cap, period limit or maximum is stated in the cashback T&C. App and wallet terms on mobikwik.com were not read.
The "funding transaction" exclusion has two MCCs: the cashback table says 5406, the shared excluded table (headed SuperCash and Cashback) says 6540. Both are excluded here.

The rewards T&C carries no revision date beyond "effective 1 Feb 2026" and also lists the older SuperCash rates (10% online and POS, 5% and 1% UPI) that ended 31 Jan 2026. Only the cashback programme is modelled.
The page FAQ (items 7-10) says a 1% processing fee on rent and education applies from 15 Jul 2026 without naming variants. MITC Table 07 shows 0% for this card, so no surcharge is modelled.
The minimum FD and eligibility rules are not stated in any SBM document read for this card.
Fuel surcharge: the KFS says "Surcharge Fee 1% of the transaction amount"; MITC clause 8.7 ties it to fuel. No waiver is stated.
notes: Different product from suryoday-mobikwik-first-rupay-platinum: issuer is SBM Bank (India) Ltd, not Suryoday Small Finance Bank, with its own KFS (forex 3%, interest 3.5% a month, late fee 2.5% or ₹200, cash fee 2.5% or ₹250). The Suryoday card has forex 2.5% and interest 2.95% a month.
Cashback is credited to the MobiKwik Wallet within 7 working days of statement generation and is forfeited if no wallet is opened within 30 days of bill generation.
Cash interest 3.5% a month from day one; cash limit 30% of the credit limit.

value.rule: 2.5% of the total outstanding or ₹200, whichever is higher, + GST
value.source: MobiKwik First KFS (12 Oct 2026) and MITC Table 08
